en.headline: John Lee says Hongkong Post must be reformed after heavy losses
en.dek: The Chief Executive said transition arrangements were inevitable as about 200 staff finishing probation in September will be offered two-year contracts instead of permanent terms.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said Hongkong Post must be reformed, after the department told staff completing probation in September that they would be kept on two-year civil service contracts rather than permanent terms. About 200 postal officers and postmen are affected.

Speaking after a Sham Shui Po visit on Wednesday, Lee said Hongkong Post operates as a trading fund on a commercial, self-financing basis and faces a changed postal market. He said the department recorded a loss of about HK$800 million in 2024/25 and that the government had recently sought more than HK$4 billion from the Legislative Council as three-year operating funds.

Lee said the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau would study a reform plan and put it to the legislature. He added that drawing up proposals would take time, so special arrangements during a transition period were unavoidable, and that Hongkong Post and the Civil Service Bureau should keep talking with staff.

zh.headline: 李家超：香港郵政必須改革 約200人改兩年合約
zh.dek: 行政長官指郵政署2024/25年度虧損約8億元，商經局將研究改革方案提交立法會；9月試用期屆滿員工改以兩年公務員合約續聘。
body: 行政長官李家超表示，香港郵政必須改革。郵政署早前公布，約200名將於9月完成試用期的郵務員及郵差，不會獲發長期聘用條款，改以兩年期公務員合約續聘。
李家超周三在深水埗探訪後見記者時說，香港郵政以營運基金、商業模式自負盈虧運作，郵政生態已有很大轉變。他指部門在2024/25年度虧損約8億元，當局近期需向立法會申請40多億元，作為香港郵政未來三年營運資金。
他說商務及經濟發展局會盡快研究改革方向，有方案後提交立法會討論，但制訂方案需時，過渡期有特別安排在所難免。他要求香港郵政及公務員事務局在過渡期間與員工保持溝通，盡量提供協助。
